raw:
SELECT AVG(t.Price) as avg_transaction_amount
FROM main."transactions_1k" t
JOIN main."customers" c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date BETWEEN DATE '2012-08-23' AND DATE '2012-08-26'
  AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment = 'LAM'

SELECT AVG(t.Price) as avg_transaction_amount
FROM main."transactions_1k" t
JOIN main."customers" c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date BETWEEN DATE '2012-08-23' AND DATE '2012-08-26'
  AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
